mapper.select: /* AppLeaveApprovalMapper.selectLeaveReqMeta */ SELECT R.REQ_ID AS reqId , R.REQ_TYPE AS reqType , R.REQ_STATUS AS reqStatus , R.USER_CD AS userCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(R.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', R.USER_CD, null) AS requesterUserNm , R.SITE_CD AS siteCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(R.CMPNY_CD, 'NODE', R.SITE_CD, COALESCE(R.NODE_CD, U.NODE_CD)) AS nodeNm , R.WORK_YMD AS workYmd , R.TARGET_ID AS targetId , R.REQ_REASON AS reqReason , DATE_FORMAT(R.INSERT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS reqDate FROM TB_USER_ATTD_REQ R LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON U.CMPNY_CD = R.CMPNY_CD AND U.USER_CD = R.USER_CD WHERE R.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND R.REQ_ID = #{reqId} AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' LIMIT 1

/* AppLeaveApprovalMapper.selectLeaveBody */ SELECT U.LEAVE_CD AS leaveCd , LT.LEAVE_NM AS leaveNm , CASE WHEN FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(U.CMPNY_CD, 'SYST_VAL', LT.PAID_TYPE, 'SYS023') LIKE '%유급%' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS paidYn , U.USE_UNIT_TYPE AS useUnitType , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(U.CMPNY_CD, 'SYST_VAL', U.USE_UNIT_TYPE, 'SYS025') AS unitNm , U.LEAVE_DAYS AS leaveDays , U.LEAVE_MINUTES AS leaveMinutes , U.START_DATE AS startDate , U.START_TIME AS startTime , U.END_DATE AS endDate , U.END_TIME AS endTime FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_USE U LEFT JOIN TB_LEAVE_TYPE_MGMT LT ON LT.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND LT.LEAVE_CD = U.LEAVE_CD WHERE U.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND U.DEL_YN = 'N' AND ( (U.REQ_ID = #{reqId} AND U.LEAVE_STATUS = 'CONFIRMED') OR (#{targetId} IS NOT NULL AND U.LEAVE_ID = #{targetId}) ) ORDER BY U.INSERT_DATE DESC LIMIT 1
